Event.description: Unique identifiers for marine expedition sampling events.

Sample ID.description: Unique identifier for marine expedition samples, combining numeric and alphanumeric formats.

Expedition.description: Unique identifiers for marine research expeditions.

Date/Time.description: Timestamps of marine expedition data collection events between 2004 and 2021.

Year sampl.description: Integer values representing the calendar year of sample collection.

Vessel.description: Identifies the research vessel used for marine expeditions.

Station.description: Alphanumeric identifiers for marine expedition sampling stations.

Gear.description: Type of sampling gear used during marine expeditions.

Depth water.description: Water depth in meters, ranging from 0 to 738, with a mean of 109.9.

Depth water_2.description: Water depth in meters recorded during marine expeditions.

Location.description: Geographic region of marine expedition sampling, including Chatham Rise, Southern Ocean, Northeast Pacific, and Hawaii.

Latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees, ranging from -69.04 to 50.94.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinates in decimal degrees ranging from -158.259 to 179.03683.

Species UID.description: Unique identifier for salp species observed in marine expeditions.

Species UID (Semantic URI).description: Unique identifiers for marine species taxa using the LSID standard.

Species UID (URI).description: Uniform Resource Identifiers linking to marine species taxonomic details.

Order.description: Taxonomic order of salp specimens, specifically Salpida or Pyrosomida.

Size.description: Salp size measurements in millimeters, ranging from 10.2 to 1000.

Tissue descriptor.description: Identifies the specific biological tissue sample type analyzed, such as whole, tunic, or stomach.

Method comm.description: Method of collection, categorized as either FD or OD.

No spec.description: Integer count of salp specimens collected during marine expeditions.

Life stage.description: Categorical code for the developmental life stage of the sampled salps.

Con m.description: Concentration of carbon in milligrams per cubic meter.

Mass.description: Salp biomass measurements in grams, ranging from 64.3 to 589.4.

Sample dm.description: Sample dry mass in grams for marine salp specimens collected during expeditions.

Mass_2.description: Mass2 records salp biomass in milligrams, ranging from 59.3 to 472.6.

Ash m.description: Ash mass in milligrams, ranging from 1.1 to 225.7.

afdm.description: Ash-free dry mass of salps in milligrams per liter.

afdm_2.description: Ash-free dry mass of salps measured in milligrams per liter.

C/dm.description: Carbon-to-dry-mass ratio expressed as a percentage of total dry weight.

N/dm.description: Nitrogen concentration in decimeters, ranging from 0.65 to 9.51.

H/dm.description: Salp carbon-to-nitrogen ratio expressed as a dimensionless float value.

C/N.description: Continuous float values representing the carbon-to-nitrogen ratio in salp samples.

C/N_2.description: Carbon-to-nitrogen ratio of salp biomass, ranging from 3.45 to 9.03.

C/H.description: Carbon-to-hydrogen atomic ratio in salp biomass samples.

H/C.description: H/C ratio values ranging from 0.08 to 0.72.

Comment.description: Elemental composition ratios of carbon, nitrogen, and hydrogen in salp biomass samples.

H.description: Continuous float values ranging from 0.45 to 6.12, likely representing a specific elemental composition metric.

H2O res.description: Water content percentage in salp samples, ranging from 1.52 to 21.79.

Sum.description: Sum of elemental composition values for salp biomass samples collected during marine expeditions.

Sum_2.description: Sum2 records continuous salp biomass measurements ranging from 35.75 to 108.84.

Elevation.description: Elevation values in meters, ranging from -5371.0 to -3796.0.

961147.description: Records salp biomass, elemental composition, and collection metadata from marine expeditions.
